activity_summary: At Old Swan, Davy Gannet took you up on the last of the flood. The fare was two pence to Whitehall, the standing fare. The stairs were iron. He did not promise a boat home. You did not ask him for news.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Asked for Canon Row and for water, and not for news.

entities.name: Davy Gannet
entities.context: Named the two pence, the last of the flood, and no boat home.

entities.name: Canon Row
entities.context: Mentioned in The last of the flood

facets.activity: Took the last of the flood

quotes.speaker: davy_gannet
quotes.text: Two pence to Whitehall, master, same as ever.

quotes.speaker: davy_gannet
quotes.text: I will not promise a boat home. Midnight is no water for this.
